messages:
alex: quick update on token-cost attribution — schema_v2 proto landed but staging ingest smoke test is failing. seeing a bunch of events with token_type NULL from older clients, so attribution math is broken.
cindy: yup reproducing. smoke log shows parser assumes token_type exists. failing jobs: attribution-processor-1 (staging). error: KeyError('token_type') in /ingest/parse.py:72 :facepalm:
sara: if we add a fallback map we can still compute a coarse cost bucket until clients upgrade. propose map: unknown->'legacy' and record ingest.missing_token_type counter.

cindy: quick repro SQL I used to find missing rows:
```
-- count events missing token_type in the last 7 days
SELECT count(*)
FROM ingestion_events
WHERE token_type IS NULL
  AND event_ts >= '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z';
```

vijay: also seeing p99 latency spikes in the tokenization->generation hop for seq_len > 2048. schema_v2 needs a seq_len_bucket field so we can slice latency by sequence length. otherwise our heatmaps are noisy.

devops-bot: deploy status: staging/attribution v2 -> FAILED (tests: 84/86 passed). See CI: https://ci.redwood/2345 :warn:

alex: owners — can we assign: ingest parsing & fallback = @cindy, schema bump + event contract = @vijay, fallback mapping + telemetry = @sara. will @leanne coordinate canary timing with infra?

leanne: I can do canary Thursday 10:00 PT. note: eng-ml needs to sign off on sample sets for quality check — @vijay please confirm the eval harness can run on staging snapshots.

vijay: confirmed. will add sample_set=canary_v2 to eval harness and run a quick quality smoke. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

cindy: I'll open two PRs — one: safe fallback in ingestion (feature flag), two: migration job to backfill token_type where we can infer it from metadata. pinging @eng-ml for heuristics.

sara: ingestion fallback (python snippet):
```
def normalize_token_type(e):
    t = e.get('token_type')
    if not t:
        metrics.increment('ingest.missing_token_type')
        return 'legacy'
    return t
```
```
add to parse pipeline behind FF: attrib.v2_fallback
```

vijay: add alert ask: please create alert-ingest-missing-token-type (threshold: >1000/day) and a dashboard tile for seq_len_bucket vs p99.

alex: thanks everyone. next steps:
- cindy: PRs + backfill plan (today)
- sara: add fallback + metrics (today)
- vijay: eval harness run + alert + seq_len field change (tomorrow)
- leanne: schedule canary Thurs 10PT and reserve rollback window
I'll circle back after canary precheck. ping here with short status updates only — no long threads pls :thumbsup:
